blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 64-year-old man was found dead inside his home in Purok 7, Barangay Cantao-an, Naga City, Cebu, on Tuesday morning, September 22, 2026. The victim was identified as Antonio Laput Sasan, a resident of the area. Authorities received a call from the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) at around 10:30 a.m. regarding a recovered body, according to the City of Naga Police Station. Responding police officers immediately proceeded to the location and confirmed the incident.
